_comment: ILLUSTRATIVE EXAMPLE. No such release exists and the digests below are the SHA-256 of a label string, not of any model file - they are here so the shape can be validated. A build that shipped them would be refused at install time when the real artifact hashed to something else. Validated by tests/test_manifest.py and by `python -m vesta_router manifest`.

shape.quantization: cactus-quants embedding=4, mhc=4, default=2; kv cache int8

releaseNotes: First promoted router build against tool schema v2 (Vesta's production tool surface). peakMemoryMb is deliberately absent: the spike measured ~131 MB on one device and that is not a per-release figure, so it is not reported rather than reported as a number it is not.
